A ubiquitous bundle has the highest probability of being verified
everywhere, even by clients using outdated or unusual trust stores. An optimal
bundle uses the shortest chain and newest intermediates. And the force bundle

methods.summary: Enable or disable Auto-Origin TLS KEX selection for the zone by sending `{"enabled": true}` or `{"enabled": false}`.
methods.description:
Enable or disable Auto-Origin TLS KEX selection for the zone by sending
`{"enabled": true}` or `{"enabled": false}`. When enabled, Cloudflare runs a
periodic scan of the zone's origins to determine the preferred key-exchange
algorithm and writes that preference to the edge so it is sent first in the TLS
ClientHello to the origin.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Controls enablement of Auto-Origin TLS KEX selection for the zone.

methods.description:
When enabled, Cloudflare automatically selects the preferred TLS key-exchange
algorithm to use when establishing the TLS connection to the zone's origin,
picking from the algorithms permitted by the zone's
`origin_tls_compliance_modes` setting. When disabled, the default key-exchange
ordering is used.

props.description:
Disabling Universal SSL removes any currently active Universal SSL
certificates for your zone from the edge and prevents any future Universal SSL
certificates from being ordered. If there are no advanced certificates or custom
certificates uploaded for the domain, visitors will be unable to access the
domain over HTTPS.

settings and preferences will result in visitors being unable to visit your
domain unless you have uploaded a custom certificate or purchased an advanced
certificate.
